records.title: NCETM — Finding equivalent fractions and simplifying fractions
records.use: Equivalent expressions denote the same number; multiplicative explanation follows the invariant visual proportion. Simplifying is not required here.
records.ageAdaptation: English Year5 procedure extends beyond the frozen recognition goal. Core starts with halves/quarters; multiplication is optional strong support.
